claims: McNeese State University is a public university in Lake Charles, Louisiana.
McNeese State University was founded in 1939.
McNeese State University offers over 100 academic programs.
McNeese State University has a 70–78% acceptance rate.
The campus of McNeese State University features a 122-acre main site.
The mascot of McNeese State University is Rowdy (Cowboys/Cowgirls).
Tuition at McNeese State University for 2023-2024 is ~$8,460 (in-state) to ~$9,960 (out-of-state).
Student population at McNeese State University is ~6,556 (Fall 2025).
McNeese State University has colleges of Agriculture, Business, Education, Engineering/Science, Liberal Arts, and Nursing.
McNeese State University has over 100 student organizations.
McNeese State University has Greek life.
McNeese State University has the Elizabeth and Leslie Richard Student Union.
Athletics at McNeese State University is a member of the NCAA Division I Southland Conference.
McNeese State University has undergraduate research projects on coastal restoration.
McNeese State University has undergraduate research projects on health sciences.
Joe Dumars is an alumnus of McNeese State University.
Joe Dumars is an NBA Hall of Famer.
Willie Mount is an alumnus of McNeese State University.
Willie Mount is a former Louisiana State Senator.
Kerry Joseph is an alumnus of McNeese State University.
Kerry Joseph is a professional football player.
McNeese State University sustained damage from hurricanes in 2020.
McNeese State University has rebuilt with new facilities like the Richard Student Union.
The men's basketball team of McNeese State University has March Madness appearances.
